subject: Renewal runway: top-up billing sync & uplift reconciliation
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Morgan <aisha.morgan@nimbus.ai>, Procurement <procurement@nimbus.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-20T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal runway: top-up billing sync & uplift reconciliation

Hi Aisha —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Per our conversation, attached is a concise term sheet for the mid-contract top-up we discussed (250k token-class capacity). High level:

- Proposed top-up: add 250k committed tokens to your Dedicated pool (starts on sign).
- Billing: option A) pro-rated monthly invoices for the remainder of your current term, or B) annualize the top-up and co-term to Jan 31, 2027 with a blended discount.
- Pricing: list price is $0.004/token; we can offer an uplift-managed discount depending on annualization and total committed volume (details in the sheet).

Ask: please confirm whether Procurement prefers a) monthly pro-rata invoicing now, or b) convert to a 12-month bridge that co-terms to Jan 31, 2027 (we can apply a 10% volume uplift discount if you commit to the 12-month path). Once you confirm approach we’ll send a DocuSign and route the PO.

Attachments: 20261001-nimbus-term-sheet-v2.pdf (term sheet), usage-report-sep.csv (recent usage snapshot).

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm preferred billing cadence (pro-rata monthly vs. co-term annualize).
2) We produce an invoice schedule and DocuSign link.
3) Procurement issues PO; onboarding scheduled within 3 business days after signature.

Happy to jump back on a quick call if you want to walk the numbers.

—
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
(415) 555-0128

From: Aisha Morgan <aisha.morgan@nimbus.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@nimbus.ai>, Carl Reyes <carl.reyes@nimbus.ai>
Date: 2026-09-22T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal runway: top-up billing sync & uplift reconciliation

Jordan —

Appreciate the clear summary. A few clarifying questions from Procurement and Finance:

1) Can you send a line-item monthly pro-rate example (how the first two invoices would look) if we choose option A? We need this to model cashflow.
2) If we choose to annualize and co-term, what exact discount tiers apply at our account size (we’re looking for transparency on how you step discounts vs committed volume)?
3) Security check: our security team wants to confirm there’s no change to data handling for the top-up and to see SOC2 evidence (a pointer to the report or a short assurance statement is fine).

Procurement leans toward a monthly pro-rata approach but would consider the co-term if the discount improves materially (>10% effective). Could Ben or someone on your side confirm the technical implications of bursting vs committed throughput?

If you can get the sample invoices and SOC2 pointer over by EOD Friday (9/24), I’ll route to Finance.

Thanks,
Aisha Morgan
Head of Platform Partnerships | Nimbus Analytics
aisha.morgan@nimbus.ai

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Morgan <aisha.morgan@nimbus.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-25T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal runway: top-up billing sync & uplift reconciliation

Aisha —

Great questions — answers below and attached an updated term sheet (v2) with explicit invoice examples.

1) Pro-rate example (Option A):
   - Month 1 invoice: pro-rated portion of the top-up (250k tokens * list price * days remaining / 365) + standard monthly consumption.
   - Month 2 invoice: full monthly amortized portion (if still mid-term) + consumption.
   (See invoice schedule, page 2 of the attached term sheet).

2) Discount tiers:
   - Annualize & co-term (12 months): 10% off list on the top-up tranche at your current band.
   - 24-month commit: 15% off list.
   - If you remain mid-band and add +$500k in net committed spend across products we can revisit a stretch to 12%.

3) SOC2: we host a scoped SOC2 Type II report (control evidence for our inference platform). I’ve attached a short compliance pointer in the doc links and will have our security team send the redacted SOC2 attestation to your security mailbox by EOD.

Operational note from Finance (Lauren): if Procurement wants the monthly pro-rate invoices we can emit an interim invoice and then true-up at the co-term if you later elect to annualize — this makes cashflow predictable for you while keeping the annualization option open.

DocuSign: I can issue a DocuSign if you confirm Option A vs B. If you go with Option B (annualize), we’ll include the 10% discount language and set the co-term to Jan 31, 2027.

Attachments: 20261001-nimbus-term-sheet-v2.pdf (term sheet with invoice examples).

Best,
Jordan

On a related note: Ben, could you confirm the burst-to-commit ceiling and any SLO caveats so Aisha’s team can sign off on operational impact?

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Morgan <aisha.morgan@nimbus.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal runway: top-up billing sync & uplift reconciliation

Aisha — quick technical note from infra/SE. See attached SLA breakdown for reference. Key points:

- The top-up is committed capacity; burst capacity remains available up to an extra 15% of committed throughput for short windows (typical spike protection).
- Bursts beyond that are served best-effort and will be billed as overage (we can cap overage notifications and create alerts).
- There is no change to data handling or tenancy when you add a top-up — same VPC controls and encryption at rest/in transit remain in place.

Attachment: SLA-breakdown.pdf (SLA/throughput and burst policy summary).

If you want, I can create a short one-page note explicitly stating "no change to data access controls" for your security team to keep with the PO.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Aisha Morgan <aisha.morgan@nimbus.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@nimbus.ai>
Date: 2026-10-01T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal runway: top-up billing sync & uplift reconciliation

Jordan —

Thanks — the examples and notes are helpful. Procurement will proceed with Option A (monthly pro-rate invoices) for the immediate top-up so we can get capacity online quickly, but Finance has agreed to a conditional annualize at co-term if you include the 10% discount in the redline.

Conditions:
- Please redline term sheet to explicitly state monthly pro-rate invoicing on first invoice and the 10% annualization discount if we elect to co-term to Jan 31, 2027.
- Send the SOC2 pointer and Ben’s one-page data-handling confirmation to security@nimbus.ai.
- Procurement will issue a PO by 2026-10-07 and will sign DocuSign once the redline is in place.

When you send the redline I’ll route to Finance & Procurement for final signatures.

Best,
Aisha
Head of Platform Partnerships | Nimbus Analytics
